subject: txn: check MDL when starting and committing pipelined txns (#51794)
summary: Diff only changes `pkg/session/session.go` (plus a realtikv test): pipelined DML is now gated on `SessionVars.TxnCtx.EnableMDL` (warn+fallback when MDL is off), and commit defensively errors if a pipelined txn somehow reaches commit with MDL disabled. Reviewed the txn/MDL wiring (`EnterNewTxn` sets `TxnCtx.EnableMDL`, planner MDL locking checks it) and found no Blocker/High correctness, consistency, concurrency, or session/txn semantic issues in this change. In later upstream history, the commit-time guard was refactored/moved (to `pkg/sessiontxn/isolation/base.go`) without changing intent.
